verdict.rationale: Stagehand is an SDK whose product surface is a documented programmatic API. The docs cover the `act()`, `extract()` and `observe()` primitives with typed output shapes, plus reference pages such as `BrowserClipboard` and browser launch and connect options, across TypeScript, Python and Go. An llms.txt index and AI-rules page support agent-driven use, and community users confirm they drive it programmatically. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/REST spec (all probed paths returned 404).
